name: SEH Grant in Herpetology
summary: Two grants of up to EUR 5,000 for amphibian and reptile conservation projects in Europe and the Mediterranean, focused on a species or a habitat. Applicants must be SEH members.

eligibility.rule: Maintains an active SEH membership status

documents: Short curriculum vitae of the prospective candidate(s)
Project outline with timetable, goals and means
Financial plan with other financial support and funding rationale

status.quote: The deadline for applications is 12th January 2026

deadline.quote: The deadline for applications is 12th January 2026

geography.quote: conservation of the amphibians and reptiles of Europe and the Mediterranean basin

access.quote: they should be sent to the SEH Council (e-mail: newsseh@gmail.com) as PDF Files

window.quote: The deadline for applications is 12th January 2026

amount.quote: with two grants of up to EUR 5,000 each

effort.quote: The deadline for applications is 12th January 2026, and they should be sent to the SEH Council (e-mail: newsseh@gmail.com) as PDF Files

eligibility.quote: The precondition of the application is an active SEH membership status.

after_award.quote: a report (to be published in AMRE and on the SEH website) will be submitted to the SHE Council and SEH Committees immediately after the project has been completed.

documents.quote: A short curriculum vitae of the prospective candidate(s).
An outline of the project, including a timetable, the goals that are intended to be achieved and the means for reaching these goals.
A financial plan, including a statement on other financial support for the project and should include a statement on why SEH funding is being requested.
